summary: Atmos Energy Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a registered public offering of $700 million 4.750% Senior Notes due 2032 under an existing S-3 shelf. The underwriting agreement is with J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, and Wells Fargo as representatives. Net proceeds are approximately $693.9 million after discounts and expenses. The notes are issued under a 2009 indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee. The offering is expected to close June 18, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
